szoveg_eredeti:
While most jack-o-lanterns sit on porches today, our team at Google DeepMind decided to let AI agents design, simulate, and bring one to life. 🎃🤖

Our end-to-end pipeline goes from a high-level prompt to a physical, walking, and dancing 12 degrees of freedom quadruped robot, with zero direct CAD modeling required.

We guided the agents with plain-English feedback, and they handled the programmatic CAD synthesis, physics simulation, and assembly planning. While fully autonomous digital-to-physical compilation is still in its infancy—requiring our hands-on team for the final 3D printing and assembly—closing this loop is an exciting leap forward for automated hardware design!

👀 Keep an eye out for our full technical write-up coming soon!
